description: Serverless customer support chatbot handling order queries, returns, and agent escalation

intents.description: Welcomes user and presents available capabilities
responses: Hello! Welcome to Customer Support. I can help you track orders, initiate returns, check refund policies, or connect you with a human agent. How can I help today?

intents.description: Checks the status of an existing customer order

slots.name: orderId
slots.prompt: Please provide your order ID (e.g., ORD1001, ORD1024) so I can check the current status.

intents.description: Provides tracking number, carrier and expected delivery date

slots.name: orderId
slots.prompt: Please tell me the Order ID you want to track.

intents.description: Initiates a product return and refund review workflow
sampleUtterances: I want to return my product
How can I return an item?
I need to request a return

slots.name: orderId
slots.prompt: Sure. Please provide your order ID to initiate the return process.

slots.name: returnReason
slots.prompt: What is the reason for your return? (e.g., Defective, Wrong size, Changed mind)

intents.description: Explains refund policy or checks specific order refund state
sampleUtterances: When will I get my refund?

slots.name: orderId
slots.description: Optional order ID to check refund status

intents.description: Lists product categories and answers product inquiries
Escalates conversation to a live human representative with support ticket
sampleUtterances: I want to talk to an agent

intents.description: Provides hours of operation and customer support availability
sampleUtterances: What time does customer service close?
responses: Our customer support team is available Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. However, this AI assistant is online 24/7 to help you track orders and create support tickets anytime!
Thank you for contacting customer support. Have a wonderful day! If you need anything else, feel free to ask.

intents.description: Default intent invoked when utterance is not recognized
responses: I am not sure I understood that. You can ask me to track an order (e.g., 'Where is order ORD1001?'), request a return, check our refund policy, or type 'talk to an agent' for human support.
